entries.t: <FACE:01>Sekiran!<NL>That one's strong!<WAIT>Team up with us and<NL>fight it!
<FACE:70>What?! You lot?!<WAIT>Kids shouldn't stick<NL>their noses in!
<FACE:71>What's that, Nyuudou?!<WAIT>Now even you're taking<NL>orders from kids?!
<FACE:70>I've got to show them<NL>real adult strength!
<FACE:71>What are you doing?!<WAIT>Wait…<DELAY:0014> he's after…<DELAY:0014> me!<DELAY:0014><NL>You lot<DELAY:0014> go on…<DELAY:0014> ahead!<WAIT>You're in a hurry!
<FACE:70>Kids should just do<NL>what grown-ups say…<WAIT>…at a time like this<DELAY:001E>…

<FACE:6D>Sekiran…<WAIT>That's not right…<WAIT><FACE:70>Nyuudou?<WAIT><FACE:6C>At a time like this<NL>age means nothing<WAIT>If we don't team up<NL>we all go down<WAIT>Yours truly was saved<NL>by kids too…
<FACE:71>Oh, shut up!<WAIT>A cute kid is one who<NL>does as she's told!<WAIT>Nosy brats like you<NL>aren't cute at all!!
<FACE:70>Well, Nyuudou…<NL>still tacky as ever…<WAIT>but back there…<NL>you looked cool…<WAIT>And I owe you one…<NL>
<FACE:72>Guess big sis will<NL>lend a hand too!
<FACE:05>So, Sekiran, which<NL>Block is next?<WAIT><FACE:70>Smog's, I'd say
<FACE:00>Come to think of it,<NL>this spaceship…<WAIT>I only see Medabots…<NL>what's that about?
